{{Quote|The officer wearing green patches is Captain Brast'alshi'barku, the line commander of this vessel&mdash;you may address him as Captain Talshib.|[[Aristocra/Legends|Aristocra]] [[Chaf'orm'bintrano]]|<ref name="Survivor's Quest" />}}
The [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Brast'alshi'barku]] belonged<ref name="Survivor's Quest" /> to one of the [[Ruling Families/Legends|Nine Ruling Families]] of the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]]. Every Chiss Ruling Family was associated with a specific [[Color/Legends|color]],<ref name="OF Ruling Family" /> and that of this '''family''' was green.<ref name="Survivor's Quest" />

In [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]], Chiss [[Force Commander]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]] of the [[Chiss Expansionary Fleet/Legends|Chiss Expansionary Fleet]]'s [[Picket Force Two/Legends|Picket Force Two]] impounded a [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]], the ''[[Bargain Hunter]]'', which was captained by [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Dubrak Qennto]] and crewed by [[Jorj Car'das]] and [[Maris Ferasi]]. Two [[Chiss warrior/Legends|Chiss warriors]] belonging to the family and sporting green shoulder patches on their black uniforms helped to bring the smugglers aboard the ''[[Springhawk/Legends|Springhawk]]'', a [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] under the [[Commander/Legends|command]] of Mitth'raw'nuruodo&mdash;known to the smugglers by his [[Core name/Legends|core name]]: Thrawn.<ref name="Outbound Flight">[[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']]</ref>

The family retained their position at least<ref name="Survivor's Quest" /> until [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]],<ref name="Survivor's Quest Date" /> but were absent from a reduced list of four Ruling Families supplied in a report by the [[University of Sanbra]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]],<ref name="The Chiss">{{GamerCite|5|The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Chiss}}</ref> and were also absent during a Jedi [[Hunt for Zonama Sekot|mission]] to [[Csilla/Legends|Csilla]]<ref name="Force Heretic II">''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic II: Refugee]]''</ref> in [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]].<ref name="Force Heretic II Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The New Jedi Order: Force Heretic II: Refugee]]'' to [[28 ABY/Legends|28 ABY]].</ref> This discrepancy remained unexplained until [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]],<ref name="Joiner King Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]'' to [[35 ABY/Legends|35 ABY]].</ref> when it was asserted that five of the Nine Ruling Families had fallen from power due to a [[Chiss civil conflict|civil conflict]] in the Chiss Ascendancy,<ref name="Joiner King">''[[Dark Nest I: The Joiner King]]''</ref> which was not unprecedented as the number of Ruling Families fluctuated between three and twelve throughout Chiss history.<ref name="Outbound Flight" />
